messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — we have an infra apply scheduled for tonight 23:00 UTC during the release change window. This touches core-networking/provider.tf (bump provider to 4.12.0) and the tenant VPC route tables. I want a short preflight checklist and a quiet-window plan before we hit apply. @jordan @sam can you own canary and rollback criteria?
jordan: I can run the canary in staging at 22:00 UTC and validate connectivity + cross-account peering routes. Will post smoke tests.
sam: I’ll prepare a provider pin fallback (4.11.x) and a quick rollback script. Also want to ensure the deploybot circuit breaker is set to 50% failed applies.
lee: Ops note — please disable autoscaling group scale-outs for the window, and set ELB drain-time to 300s. I’ll monitor for AZ routing flaps.
deploybot: @maria noted. Plan accepted. Preflight: `terraform plan -var-file=prod.tfvars -target=module.core-networking` will run at 22:05 UTC in the canary workspace. Canary apply will be auto-rolled backed on >3 errors within 10m.
maria: copy. Jordan, post the minimal smoke tests you’ll run (curl endpoints, traceroute, auth check). Keep them short.
jordan: smoke tests (quick list):
```
- curl https://api.internal.healthz -> 200
- traceroute to 10.12.0.1 <= 6 hops
- cross-account S3 put/get (creds: canary-role)
- auth flow: oauth token request + /userinfo
```
sam: added rollback snippet to runbook: `#!/bin/bash\nset -e\n# revert provider\ngit checkout -b revert-provider-$CI_BUILD_ID\n# terraform apply -var-file=prod.tfvars -target=module.core-networking`
Will attach to the incident channel if triggered.
lee: Also add a route-table snapshot before apply: `aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters ... > /tmp/rt-snapshot.json` so we can diff.
ops-bot: Reminder: quiet window lock enabled for eng-infra at 22:50 UTC by @maria. Notifications will be suppressed except for @ops oncall and @eng-leads.
maria: good. One more ask — pin tf provider in the module registry for the canary so we can rapid revert if provider binary change causes drift. Sam?
sam: done. I created a pinned module version and uploaded the fallback provider artifact to internal S3. Added instructions in the runbook.
jordan: staging canary completed at 22:25 UTC — all smoke tests passed, no peering regressions. Logs attached.
maria: awesome. Ok let's keep the quiet window, proceed with serial apply: canary -> 10% prod -> 50% prod -> full. Deploybot will gate each wave.
deploybot: Serial apply configured: waves [canary, wave-10pct, wave-50pct, full]. Auto-fallback to previous state on failed validation. Thresholds: 5 failed requests or 2 route flaps per wave.
lee: monitoring hooks: added synthetic hits and increased log retention for the window. Pager policy set to oncall.
maria: final sanity check before 23:00: are all owners reachable? jordan/sam/lee/respond please.
jordan: here, oncall reachable.
sam: here, runbook ready.
lee: here, monitoring primed.
maria: :thumbsup: commencing apply at 23:00 UTC. If anything funky, signal rollback in this thread and run the script.
ops-bot: Quiet window enabled. Alerting escalation to oncall.
maria: Post-apply note: when rolling back, include the provider pin revert and route-table snapshot restore steps. I’ll file a short release note after the window.
(END)
